info.title: API.SH: Instagram
info.description: The Instagram API from API.SH: public Instagram data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Total post count of a hashtag, related hashtags with their post counts (also grouped as frequent / average / rare), related searches, and the top posts Instagram shows for it with average plays. `posts=false` returns the counts and related hashtags only. Recent posts of a hashtag are shown only to logged-in visitors and are not included.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/instagram-hashtag

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Hashtag, with or without #.

parameters.name: posts
parameters.description: Include top posts (default true).

get.description:
An Instagram location page as shown logged out: name, category, coordinates, address, city, zip, phone, price range, the number of posts tagged there, and its top posts (about 15, with caption, media, likes and comments). Logged out, Instagram refuses further pages, so `next_cursor` is always null.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/instagram-location

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Location id, or a instagram.com/explore/locations/<id>/... URL in `url`.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Location page URL (instead of id).

get.description:
The accounts Instagram suggests as similar to a public account, in Instagram's order (up to about 80), each with username, name, verified and private flags and picture; the first `limit` public accounts also come with their followers, following, posts, bio, category, website and bio links, account type (business, creator or personal) and whether they post reels or have a story up. For the list alone use /instagram/v1/user/related. Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/instagram-user-similar

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Instagram username, @username or profile link.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many of the first similar accounts come with their stats (0-12, default 10).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
